description: Generates a public-safe mini business system review with snapshot, bottlenecks, opportunities, risks, first workflow, next step, missing information, and confidence.

aiIdea.description: AI or automation idea the user is considering.

bottlenecks.description: Known bottlenecks to include in the mini review.

businessSnapshot.description: Existing business snapshot to include or refine in the mini review.

businessType.description: Type of business, such as ecommerce, SaaS, consulting, agency, local service, or solo business.

confidence.description: Optional confidence level to carry into the report.

constraints.description: Known constraints such as budget, team capacity, tools, timeline, compliance needs, or data access.

currentGoal.description: Current business goal the user wants the review to support.

currentProblem.description: Main business or workflow problem the user wants to solve.

currentWorkflow.description: How the relevant workflow currently works, including manual steps, tools, handoffs, and review points.

goal90Days.description: Desired business or workflow outcome over the next 90 days.

nextStep.description: Existing next-step recommendation to include or refine.

notes.description: Any additional context the user wants considered in the review.

offer.description: Core product, service, package, or outcome the business sells.

opportunities.description: Known AI opportunities to include in the mini review.

preferredNextStep.description: User preference for self-guided, diagnostic, documentation, build, or review support.

recommendedWorkflow.description: Existing first workflow recommendation to include or refine.

revenueModel.description: How the business earns revenue, such as projects, retainers, subscriptions, services, or products.

riskConcerns.description: Concerns related to customer trust, brand reputation, legal exposure, sensitive data, or quality control.

risks.description: Known trust, control, customer, or implementation risks to include.

targetCustomer.description: Primary customer segment or buyer the business serves.

teamSize.description: Approximate team size and key roles involved in the workflow.

name: generate_mini_report

confidence.description: Confidence level based on the clarity and completeness of the provided business context.

disclaimer.description: Public safety note explaining the limits of the review.

missingInformation.description: Information the user should provide to improve report confidence.

recommendedAction.description: Most practical next action based on the supplied context.

reportMarkdown.description: Public-safe mini review formatted as markdown.

shortSummary.description: Brief summary of the review result.

title: Generate Mini Report
